semantic: Cap on extra Falcon Strike hits that rare/boss hits can add. Chain: FalconryMutator -> FalconAdapter(+0x98) -> FalconStrikeMutator(+0x138) -> CastAfterDuration.addedCastsOnRareBossHitRemaining(+0x2F0) (set only inside the `extraHitsFromKills > 0` block, together with addedCastsOnKillRemaining=extraHitsFromKills, chanceToAddCastOnRareBossHit(+0x300)=chanceToAddHitFromRareBossHit (flat 0.1) and addedCastsTriggerSkill(+0x2F8)=Ability 0x2f8). CastAfterDuration.OnHit: if remaining>0 and the hit ability == addedCastsTriggerSkill and target.isRareOrBoss and Roll(chance 0.1): extra casts (+0xF4) += 1, remaining -= 1, and DestroyAfterDuration.duration += castInterval(+0xE0).
formula: Per falcon strike object: up to f extra hits (f = 1 per point, max 2) can be added, each granted by a Falcon Strike hit on a rare/boss enemy with a 10% roll (chance flat 0.1 whenever node taken); each success adds one extra strike cast and lengthens the object's lifetime by one cast interval. Expected extra hits per rare/boss hit = 0.1 until f are used up. Only active if extraHitsFromKills>0 (same node).

semantic: Boolean linked-glyphs mode, set by the same node as additionalMaxGlyphs=1 ('Can place two glyphs'). In GlyphOfDominionMutator.Mutate (new glyph being placed; maxGlyphs = additionalMaxGlyphs+1): if flag && getNumberOfActiveGlyphs()==1 && maxGlyphs>=2, the first glyph gets a DestroyObjectOnDeath component with transformToDestroy = the new glyph's transform (so both glyphs die/explode together) and distanceFromLastGlyph (+0x1F0) = |pos(first glyph) - pos(new target location)| is recorded (used by moreDamagePerMeterForSecondGlyph). Otherwise (flag off or count!=1) when active glyphs >= maxGlyphs, every existing glyph's elapsed timer is set to its duration (+0x8c = +0x88) i.e. the old glyphs are forced to expire/explode before the new one.
formula: flag==1 && 1 active glyph && max>=2: second glyph is tied to the first (explodes simultaneously) and distance between them (m) is stored; else when glyph limit reached, old glyphs are detonated. No numeric value; enables the node's '+10% second glyph damage per metre (max 60%)' because distanceFromLastGlyph is only computed in this branch.
